hottest.summary: Purpose CISA strongly urges organizations to immediately patch the recently disclosed Oracle Java vulnerability CVE-2026-114938 . This critical memory-corruption vulnerability, known as “Java4Shell,” affects the Base64 decoder of the x86-64 HotSpot Java Virtual Machine (JVM), which is part of the Java Development Kit (JDK). Specially crafted Base64 input could crash the JVM and allow for unauthenticated remote code execution. Actions to take CISA urges organizations to take the following actions: Identify affected Java installations. Review your software inventory for JDKs and Java runtimes, including those bundled with third-party applications or included in container images and appliances. Note: JDKs and Java runtimes may not appear as separate entries in software inventories. Apply relevant Java and vendor patches as soon as they are available, prioritizing internet-facing systems. If immediate patching is not feasible, implement temporary compensating controls, such as restricting and validating Base64 input at the application boundary, enforcing input-size limits, and limiting unauthenticated access. Review Oracle’s security advisory for guidance on patching and affected products and versions. Monitor for indicators of suspicious activity, including rogue runtimes, unexpected JVM crashes, and suspicious Java processes. Resources CISA urges network defenders to review the following resource and apply necessary updates: Vendor Guidance Oracle’s Security Advisory: Critical Security Patch Update – November 2026 Disclaimer The information in this report is being provided “as is” for informational purposes only. CISA does not endorse any commercial entity, product, company, or service, including any entities, products, or services linked within this document. Any reference to specific commercial entities, products, processes, or services by service mark, trademark, manufacturer, or otherwise, does not constitute or imply endorsement, recommendation, or favoring by CISA. hottest.summary: CISA has added one new vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog , based on evidence of active exploitation. CVE-2026-115731 Perforce Puppet Enterprise Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability This type of vulnerability is a frequent attack vector for malicious cyber actors and poses significant risks to the federal enterprise. Binding Operational Directive (BOD) 26-04: Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk establishes vulnerability management requirements for Federal Civilian Executive Branch (FCEB) agencies. BOD 26-04 reinforces the importance of the KEV Catalog and requires federal agencies to prioritize rapid remediation of high-risk vulnerabilities, specifically those identified by Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs) listed in CISA’s KEV Catalog on publicly exposed assets that grant total control of the asset post-exploitation, while deferring action for lower-risk vulnerabilities. BOD 26-04 further establishes basic expectations for when agencies must check whether threat actors compromised the system before the patch was applied. While BOD 26-04 applies only to FCEB agencies, CISA encourages all organizations to adopt risk-based vulnerability management and prioritize remediation of KEV Catalog vulnerabilities . CISA will continue to add vulnerabilities to the catalog that meet the specified criteria . Aware of an exploited vulnerability not currently listed in the KEV Catalog? Submit it for potential addition through CISA’s KEV Nomination Form . Potential KEV additions must have a CVE ID, evidence of exploitation, and clear mitigation guidance.

persistent_hot.summary: Linuxカーネルにおいて、以下の脆弱性が修正されました。tipc: tipc_disc_rcv()内のディスカバリのuse-after-freeの修正について説明します。bearer_disable()はtipc_disc_delete()による単純なkfree()でb-＞discを解放しますが、tipc_disc_rcv()はrcu_read_lock()下のRXソフトIRQ内で依然としてb-＞discを逆参照します（tipc_udp_recv -＞ tipc_rcv -＞ tipc_disc_rcvの流れです）。L2ベアラーはtipc_disable_l2_media()内のsynchronize_net()のおかげで安全ですが、UDPベアラーはその呼び出しをcleanup_bearer()というワークキューに延期するため、ディスカバリは猶予期間なしで解放されてしまいます。BUG: KASAN: slab-use-after-free in tipc_disc_rcv (net/tipc/discover.c:149) Read of size 8 at addr ffff88802348b728 by task poc_tipc/184 ＜IRQ＞ tipc_disc_rcv (net/tipc/discover.c:149) tipc_rcv (net/tipc/node.c:2126) tipc_udp_recv (net/tipc/udp_media.c:391) udp_rcv (net/ipv4/udp.c:2643) ip_local_deliver_finish (net/ipv4/ip_input.c:241) ＜/IRQ＞ Freed by task 181: kfree (mm/slub.c:6565) bearer_disable (net/tipc/bearer.c:418) tipc_nl_bearer_disable (net/tipc/bearer.c:1001)ベアラーはkfree_rcu()で解放されるため、ディスカバリも同様に解放されます。struct tipc_discovererにrcu_headを追加し、RCUコールバックからその発見者とskbを解放する仕組みとしました。RCUコールバック（tipc_disc_free_rcu）はモジュールのテキストセクション内に存在するため、tipcモジュールがアンロードされる際に未処理のcall_rcu()が残っていると、解放済み関数が呼び出されてしまいます。bearerサブシステムの破棄後にtipc_exit()にrcu_barrier()を追加し、モジュールのテキストが消える前にすべての保留中のディスカバリのコールバックが完了するようにしました。権限のないユーザネームスペースから到達可能な脆弱性です。TIPCv2のgenlファミリはnetnsokであり、そのベアラーコマンドはGENL_ADMIN_PERMを持っていません。動作にはCONFIG_TIPCおよびCONFIG_TIPC_MEDIA_UDPの設定が必要です。
